key_insight: Orthogonal updates paired with gradient-norm-based adaptive stepsizes stabilize coupled minimax optimization while avoiding problem-dependent stepsize tuning.
engineering_relevance: For machine-learning systems formulated as minimax problems, the framework offers a way to reduce update instability and stepsize sensitivity.
method: Orthogonalize update directions to reduce update anisotropy.
Use AdaSGDA to adapt primal-dual stepsizes from accumulated gradient norms.
Add variance reduction in AdaSGDA-VR to improve the convergence rate.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical convergence rates of O(T^−1/4) for AdaSGDA and O(T^−1/3) for AdaSGDA-VR, plus extensive experiments showing competitive performance without specifying benchmarks or numerical gains.
watch_item: The stated guarantees target nonconvex–strongly-concave problems; applicability beyond that setting and implementation overhead require evaluation.
paper_title: Orthogonal Updates for the Win: Towards Accelerated Adaptive Minimax Optimization
